title: VoteVets Spends Millions to Elect Democrats, Shaping Midterms
summary: The organization, founded in 2006 to back Democratic veterans opposing the Iraq war, is pouring huge sums into this year’s elections amid intense voter antipathy for another conflict in the Middle East.
